evidence.quote: In Figure 8 we compare likelihoods and CRPS value for forecasts from traditional time series methods and LLaMA-2 70B on data that has been corrupted with missing values

practical_problems.note: missing-rate sweep (0 to 50%) comparing NaN-string encoding with interpolation baselines; the NaN formatting is a text-encoding choice that the card folds into the decimal representation

evidence.quote: To further address the memorization concern, we also perform a direct experiment to show GPT-3 also demonstrates strong performance when evaluated on time series recorded after its training data

practical_problems.note: evaluation check on three series recorded after the GPT-3 cutoff; it tests benchmark contamination of the base model, not a module calibration: post-cutoff series evaluated without a leaky contrast

summary: LLMTime encodes numbers and converts token probabilities into densities so an untuned LLM forecasts zero-shot, beating baselines on CRPS and likelihood; a missing-data sweep and a post-cutoff test probe two obstacles.
